SAMCustomDomainMetadata.description: Smarter API CustomDomain Manifest - Metadata class.

annotations.description:
The manifest annotations. Used for storing arbitrary metadata as
            key-value pairs. Example: [{'smarter.sh/test-manifest/project-name': 'Scooby dooby do'}]. The
            key should be a valid url-friendly string. The value accepts
            multi-line string values (YAML block scalars) and various scalar types including
            str, int, float, bool, datetime.date, datetime.datetime, decimal.Decimal, uuid.UUID, bytes, list, dict.
annotations.title: Annotations

description.description: The description for this resource. Be brief. Keep it under 255 characters.
description.title: Description

name.description: The camelCase name of the manifest resource
name.title: Name

tags.description: The tags of the manifest. Used for generic resource categorization and search. Example: ['tag1', 'tag2']
tags.title: Tags

version.description: The semantic version of the manifest. Example: 0.1.0
version.title: Version

SAMCustomDomainStatus.description:
Smarter API CustomDomain Manifest - Status class.

Read only. Besides ownership, it reports the domain's AWS Route53 hosted zone, whether
the domain is verified, and its DNS records. The LLMClient that uses it is reported in
``dependencies``.

accountNumber.description: CustomDomain.status.accountNumber: The account owner of this CustomDomain. Read only.
accountNumber.title: Accountnumber

awsHostedZoneId.description: CustomDomain.status.awsHostedZoneId: The AWS Route53 hosted zone of this CustomDomain, once it is registered with smarter deploy. Read only.
awsHostedZoneId.title: Awshostedzoneid

created.description: The date in which this resource was created. Read only.
created.title: Created

dependencies.description: dependencies[List]: The resources that depend on this resource, and that must be deleted, or stop referring to it, before it can be deleted. Lists only the resources that you can read. Read only.

dnsRecords.description: CustomDomain.status.dnsRecords: The DNS records of this CustomDomain. Read only.
dnsRecords.title: Dnsrecords

modified.description: The date in which this resource was most recently changed. Read only.
modified.title: Modified

recordLocator.description: recordLocator[String]: An optional identifier used to locate the resource record associated with this manifest. Read only.
recordLocator.title: Recordlocator

username.description: CustomDomain.status.username: The Smarter user who created this CustomDomain. Read only.
username.title: Username

verificationMessage.description: CustomDomain.status.verificationMessage: Why the domain is not verified yet, or why its verification failed. Read only.
verificationMessage.title: Verificationmessage

verificationStatus.description: CustomDomain.status.verificationStatus: Not Verified, Verifying, Verified or Failed. The domain is Verified when its NS records are delegated to its hosted zone, and its TLS certificate is issued. Read only.
verificationStatus.title: Verificationstatus

verifiedAt.description: CustomDomain.status.verifiedAt: When the domain was verified. Read only.
verifiedAt.title: Verifiedat
